data.one_liner: Provides input masks and validators for common data types
data.what_it_does: Mask offers a set of input formatters and validation functions for CPF, CNPJ, email, money, date, time, phone, and generic patterns. It simplifies form handling by providing ready‑made tools for formatting and validating user input.
use_when: You need to validate Brazilian CPF/CNPJ numbers
You need to format and validate monetary values
You need to format dates, times, or phone numbers in forms
You want a quick way to apply generic masks with minimal configuration
avoid_when: You require highly custom or complex validation logic beyond the provided patterns
You need international phone or date formats not covered by the defaults
strengths: Wide coverage of common Brazilian data formats
Simple API using TextFormField validators and inputFormatters
No external code generation or build steps required
weaknesses: Limited to the predefined masks; custom regex support is minimal
No support for international formats outside Brazil

alternatives.name: email_validator
alternatives.why_pick_it: Use if you only need email validation and prefer a dedicated, lightweight package

alternatives.name: file_picker_platform_interface
alternatives.why_pick_it: Not relevant – included only to show alternative list

data.minimal_example:
TextFormField(
  autovalidateMode: AutovalidateMode.onUserInteraction,
  validator: (value) => Mask.validations.money(value, min: 100.0),
  inputFormatters: [Mask.money()],
)
